chunks.text: Ansh Maurya is pursuing B.Tech in Information Technology at Kanpur Institute of Technology (AKTU), from Jan 2024 to Jul 2027.
Ansh Maurya completed Intermediate and High School from Dr. C.V. Raman Intermediate College, Panki, Kanpur.

Ansh Maurya worked as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Codec Technologies Pvt. Ltd. from Apr 2026 to Aug 2026. AICTE & ICAC approved, partnered with Google for Education, worked with distributed team across 27+ countries.

TrainTrackPro: Full stack railway tracking/booking platform with React/Vite/Tailwind, Node/Express/Prisma, Python FastAPI RAG microservice (LangChain + Sentence Transformers + Gemini API), PostgreSQL + MongoDB, Docker Compose, Nginx.
AI Agent for Semester Exam Preparation: Gemini-powered study assistant with Q&A, topic summarization, and practice question generation.
Book Data Web Scraping & Analysis: Python/BeautifulSoup scraper with Pandas/NumPy/Matplotlib/Seaborn analysis. Sentiment analysis: 57.1% positive, 42.9% negative reviews.
Inventory Management System with Sales Tracking: Full-stack solution with real-time sales tracking, CRUD operations, and reporting.

Languages: C, C++, JavaScript, Python. Frontend: React.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Vite. Backend: Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, Prisma ORM, REST APIs. Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB. Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, Docker Compose, Nginx, VS Code. AI/Data: Gemini API, LangChain, Sentence Transformers, RAG pipelines, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, BeautifulSoup, TextBlob, VADER, Web Scraping.
Full Stack Developer Internship Certificate from Codec Technologies (Apr 2026).
